summary: Narragansett Bancorp filed an 8-K disclosing an agency agreement with Piper Sandler to market common stock in a subscription and community offering tied to a two-tier holding company reorganization of Narragansett Financial Corporation (MHC) and BayCoast Bank. Piper Sandler receives fees of 1.35% of subscription offering proceeds, 3.00% of community offering proceeds, 5.00% for syndicated offerings, plus expense reimbursements capped at $140,000 and $35,000, and a $75,000 records agent fee. The offering is pursuant to Form S-1 (File No. 333-296731). No deal price or valuation is disclosed. Watch for offering pricing and results as part of the reorganization.
